title: 3-Day Hyderabad Micro Itinerary
summary: Food spots, old city walk, and a realistic weekend pace for first-time visitors.

blocks.alt: Skyline and monument illustration for Hyderabad itinerary post

blocks.value: Day one should stay compact: old city landmarks, one food street, and a short evening walk instead of trying to cover everything.
Day two is better for museums and cafe stops around central neighborhoods so transit fatigue remains low.
Keep day three light with one priority list and a buffer block. That protects the trip from delays and still gives a complete experience.
